fabricId.description: The ID of the fabric the link belongs to.

initiatorConnectorId.description: The ID of the initiating connector.

initiatorProperties.description: The initiating connector properties to set or override.

overridableInitiatorPropertyNames.description: The initiator connector properties which can be overridden by the user.

initiatorNetworkId.description: The network to use on the initiating system. null value implies use any available route.

initiatorThreadsPerQuery.description: The number of threads to use per query by the initiator

targetConnectorId.description: The ID of the initiating connector.

targetProperties.description: The target connector properties to set or override.

overridableTargetPropertyNames.description: The target connector properties which can be overridden by the user.

targetNetworkId.description: The network to use on the target system. null value implies use any available route.

targetThreadsPerQuery.description: The number of threads to use per query by the initiator

commPolicyId.description: The ID of the communication policy to use for communication with first bridge or target.

userMappingId.description: The user mapping to apply. null value implies no user mapping.

usersToTroubleshoot.description: The database users to set specific log levels on.

enableAcks.description: Enable sending acknowledgments for data blocks to enable ability to recover from transient network failures.

tags.description: Optional string key/value pairs for associating some context with the link.

initiatorNetworkId.description: The ID of the network for the initiating side of bridge, else NULL for Any.

targetNetworkId.description: The ID of the network for the target side of bridge 1, else NULL for Any.

commPolicyId.description: The ID of the communication policy to use between the next bridge or target.

threadsPerQuery.description: The number of threads to use per query by the bridge
